# Avatar

Avatars represent a person or entity as an image, initials, or an icon. Seven sizes, circular or square shape, an optional inner border ring, and avatar groups with spaced or stacked layouts. Ported from the DGA library's nds-avatar and dga-avatar-group components.

**Stylesheet:** `components/avatar/avatar.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes for configuring avatars, mapped from the library's nds-avatar and dga-avatar-group APIs.

| Class | Type | Library prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.avatar` | Base | — | Circular container with a white outer border and neutral background. |
| .avatar--image / --text / --icon | Modifier | `type` | Content type: a cover-fitted <img>, uppercase initials, or an icon glyph. |
| .avatar--120 … .avatar--24 | Modifier | `size` | Seven sizes: 120, 80, 68, 48, 40, 32, 24. Each pairs its own text and icon scale; 120 uses a 4px outer border. |
| `.avatar--square` | Modifier | `square` | Rounded square (8px radius) instead of a circle. |
| `.avatar--border` | Modifier | `border` | Adds a subtle 1px inner ring (20% black) for avatars on light imagery. |
| .avatar__text / .avatar__icon | Element | — | Initials label / icon glyph, auto-scaled by the size modifier. |
| `.avatar-group` | Base | — | Row of avatars with a 4px gap. |
| `.avatar-group--stacked` | Modifier | `stacked` | Overlapping layout (-10px), RTL-aware. |
| `.avatar-group__more` | Element | — | "+N" overflow counter avatar at the end of a group. |

## Sizes

Seven sizes from 120px to 24px. Initials and icons scale with the container; the 120 size thickens its outer border to 4px.

```html
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--120"><span class="avatar__text">sa</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--80"><span class="avatar__text">sa</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--68"><span class="avatar__text">sa</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--48"><span class="avatar__text">sa</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40"><span class="avatar__text">sa</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--32"><span class="avatar__text">sa</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--24"><span class="avatar__text">sa</span></span>
```

## Types

Image avatars cover-fit their photo; text avatars show uppercase initials; icon avatars use a glyph for anonymous or system entities.

```html
<span class="avatar avatar--image avatar--68">
    <img src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 68 68'%3E%3Crect width='68' height='68' fill='%2325935f'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='34' cy='26' r='12' fill='%23f3fcf6'/%3E%3Cellipse cx='34' cy='58' rx='21' ry='16' fill='%23f3fcf6'/%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Sample user photo">
</span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--68"><span class="avatar__text">am</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--icon avatar--68"><span class="avatar__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-user"></span></span></span>
```

## Shape & Border Ring

The square modifier switches to an 8px radius. The border modifier adds a subtle inner ring that keeps light photos separated from light backgrounds.

```html
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--68"><span class="avatar__text">am</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--68 avatar--border"><span class="avatar__text">am</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--68 avatar--square"><span class="avatar__text">am</span></span>
<span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--68 avatar--square avatar--border"><span class="avatar__text">am</span></span>
```

## Avatar Group

Groups lay avatars in a row with a 4px gap, or stack them with a -10px overlap. End the group with a "+N" counter for overflow.

```html
<span class="avatar-group">
    <span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40"><span class="avatar__text">am</span></span>
    <span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40"><span class="avatar__text">sk</span></span>
    <span class="avatar avatar--icon avatar--40"><span class="avatar__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-user"></span></span></span>
</span>



<span class="avatar-group avatar-group--stacked">
    <span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40"><span class="avatar__text">am</span></span>
    <span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40"><span class="avatar__text">sk</span></span>
    <span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40"><span class="avatar__text">rh</span></span>
    <span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40 avatar-group__more"><span class="avatar__text">+5</span></span>
</span>
```

## RTL Layout

Stacked groups overlap toward the reading direction using logical margins.

```html
<span class="avatar-group avatar-group--stacked">
    <span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40"><span class="avatar__text">أح</span></span>
    <span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40"><span class="avatar__text">مد</span></span>
    <span class="avatar avatar--text avatar--40 avatar-group__more"><span class="avatar__text">+3</span></span>
</span>
```
